SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN AVG(allocator_frag_ratio)
    ELSE 0
  END as `allocator frag`,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN AVG(allocator_rss_ratio)
    ELSE 0
  END as `allocator rss`,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN AVG(mem_fragmentation_ratio)
    ELSE 0
  END as `mem fragmentation`,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN AVG(rss_overhead_ratio)
    ELSE 0
  END as `rss overhead`
FROM redis
WHERE $__timeFilter(logstamp)

panels.description: Displays key Redis server status indicators, including background operation outcomes and configuration states, for quick system health assessment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(monotonic_clock,' ',multiplexing_api,' ',aof_last_bgrewrite_status,' ',aof_last_write_status,' ',rdb_last_bgsave_status,' ',master_failover_state,' ',atomicvar_api,'',config_file,'',executable,'',ssl_enabled) as id FROM redis limit 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('Uptime ',uptime_in_seconds),concat('Commands Processed ',instantaneous_ops_per_sec) FROM redis WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp desc limit 1

SELECT concat(process_id,'\r\n',redis_mode,' ',role,' ',redis_version,' ',gcc_version,' ',maxmemory_policy,' ',mem_allocator,' ',multiplexing_api,' ',redis_build_id,' ',os,' ',arch_bits) as id FROM redis limit 1

SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    max(evicted_clients) as `evicted_clients`,
    max(blocked_clients) as `blocked_clients`,
    max(clients_in_timeout_table) as `clients_in_timeout_table`,
    max(tracking_clients) as `tracking_clients`,
    max(rejected_connections) as `rejected_connections`,
    max(cluster_connections) as `cluster_connections`,
    max(connected_slaves) as `connected_slaves`,
    max(connected_clients) as `connected_clients`,
    max(maxclients) as `maxclients`,
    max(total_connections_received) as `total_connections_received`
FROM
  redis
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND source = '${nodes}' ${query0}
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC;
